purpose: 头顶泡泡环造型示意，不接入游戏
constraints: 只使用原始短身考拉作参考
保留原始头部、叶子与花盆比例
上半身不探出，盆沿不增加手臂
攻击从头顶泡泡环发出，嘴保持原始小微笑

variants.name: 短柄圆环
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: game character accessory concept board, NOT final production sprite. Use the ONE attached original game character as the STRICT identity, body proportion, pose and pot reference. This is the ORIGINAL short-bodied blue plush koala whose head rests just above two green felt leaves in a blue felt flower pot. Preserve that EXACT small original silhouette, head size, face, ear shape, short body hidden behind leaves, pot dimensions and cloud applique. Do not lengthen or reveal the chest, shoulders or arms. No paws on the rim, no leaning or reaching torso, no extra limbs, no change to body proportions.
Create one polished landscape concept board, 3 equal columns, pale lavender studio background matching a soft plush mobile game, restrained subtle stage shadows. In each column show the same complete original short-body toy at the same size, pot bottom on the same baseline, with the exact SAME new head-mounted bubble-blowing ring accessory. The ring is a real upright bubble wand loop with a clearly open circular center and thin iridescent soap membrane, connected to the crown of the head. It is an attachment physically mounted to the head, visually reminiscent of a little propeller accessory on a cartoon toy's head. It is NOT a floating halo, NOT a transparent spherical helmet, NOT a hoop enclosing the animal's head. The ring faces toward the viewer and slightly upward in three-quarter perspective so its opening and bubble emergence are obvious. Keep the character's ears and forehead readable. Ring outer diameter about 35 percent of the character's full head-with-ears width, stem height about 10 percent; compact enough to read on a small game pad. Yellow/cream toy-plastic ring and soft fabric mount should complement the blue plush identity, no metal machinery or weapon styling.
Columns left to right: 1. IDLE: soap membrane lies flat inside the ring, no loose bubbles. 2. INFLATE: membrane bulges out through the ring into a rounded iridescent bubble, with a visibly attached neck at the ring opening. 3. FIRE: one detached iridescent bubble flies diagonally upward from the head ring, a second very small bubble only if needed to show direction. The mouth stays the original relaxed tiny smile in all three columns, NO bubbles come from the mouth. The body stays identical across all columns; the accessory and membrane do the work.
High-quality soft fuzzy plush fibers, original bright blue and cream color scheme, gentle studio lighting, cute collectible toy aesthetic. Full accessory and projectile visible, no cropping. Leave generous headroom. No busy sparkle cloud, no giant bubbles covering the face, no game HUD. Use small tidy Chinese labels below each column exactly: "待机", "鼓泡", "发射". Upper-left clean title as specified below. Keep every other area free of text.
TITLE: "A · 短柄圆环". DESIGN: A classic unmistakable small bubble-wand ring. Creamy golden-yellow smooth rounded circular tube, subtle molded ridges on the outer edge, pale-cyan inner edge, a VERY SHORT straight mint-green support rising from a tiny soft blue felt button on the exact crown of the koala. Clean, simple single circular loop. No decorative petals or other accessories. This is the simplest and most readable silhouette.

labelCorrection.prompt: Use case: text-localization. Edit ONLY the incorrect two-character label at the BOTTOM RIGHT of this concept board. Replace it with the exact Chinese text "发射" (first character 发, second character 射), same dark-purple rounded font, size, baseline and centered placement as the existing label. Keep the title "C · 发箍泡泡环", bottom-left "待机", bottom-middle "鼓泡", all three koalas, their exact original short bodies, leaves, pots, headbands, rings, bubbles, colors, background, layout and image dimensions completely unchanged. No other edits.
